verdict.rationale: Insomnia lets users choose where project data lives: Local Vault, Cloud Sync, or Git Sync. Git Sync keeps data in any third-party Git repository you control, without going through Insomnia's cloud, so you can effectively decide residency by storing locally or in your own repo. However, nothing in the evidence shows a selectable region or data-residency setting for Insomnia's own cloud storage. Missing for 10: cloud region/data-residency selection, documented residency guarantees or compliance commitments, independent corroboration.
